definition: a toothed wheel that turns inside a machine
description: A young man in a workshop apron grins as he works an adjustable spanner on a blue circuit board at his bench, tools hanging on the pegboard behind him. Cut to him in goggles with his hair on end, holding the small board up in both hands over a heavy bench vice. Then he stands back with a screwdriver as a small mechanism is clamped in the vice, and next a larger machine with a motor and rails sits on a rolling bench in front of him, his mouth open. Finally he throws both arms up in a garage in front of a huge machine of purple pistons and interlocking metal gears.

de.answer: Er baut eine Maschine mit Zahnrädern aus Metall.
de.question: Was baut der Mann?

es.answer: Está construyendo una máquina con engranajes de metal.
es.question: ¿Qué está construyendo el hombre?

fr.answer: Il construit une machine avec des engrenages en métal.
phrases: briller en rouge et en vert
avoir de grands engrenages en métal
